Abstract Class for Data Stream Regressors

Source: R/DSRegressor.R
DSRegressor.Rd

Abstract class for data stream regressors. More implementations can be found in package streamMOA.

Usage

DSRegressor(...)

Arguments

...

Further arguments.

Other DST: DSAggregate(), DSC(), DSClassifier(), DSOutlier(), DST(), DST_SlidingWindow(), DST_WriteStream(), evaluate, predict, stream_pipeline, update
